question: Does site_occupancy@1 integrate Langmuir binding with site-conserving internalisation on finite site populations to its independent references (R-ode, R-closed, R-eq) in the registered face-free worlds: the free ligand at every node, the bound and free sites and the internalised cargo within the declared state budget at every record, at third order on q1_fast's ladder; the equilibrium against R-eq and the depletion quadratic; the heat and work against R-ode's integrals and the heat to equilibrium against G(start) - G(eq); accessibility as a pure capacity factor (theta(alpha)/theta(1) = alpha at every record, the kinetic and affinity forms caught); every ledger and the face-free energy residual at rounding, the heat non-negative, the trace's effect far below the budget; and are its runs idle, restartable and batchable bitwise, its refusals held with their reasons, and its planted misbookings caught?
engine_models: resolved_pump_composite@1 over resolved_pump_tissue@3 (the composite and its inner model)
site_occupancy@1 with its laws langmuir_site_binding@1 and site_conserving_internalisation@1 and its step ssprk33_unidirectional_stage_condition_site_bookings@1 (the operator judged)

constant_field@1 (every patch, at zero permeability) and the closure resolved_capacitor_components_current_continuity@1 with capacitive_reduction_gauged_damped_newton@2 (the quiescent ions: electrically silent)
the IDs the judged definitions print are recorded by the generator in every engine part and checked against this list before registration
scope: Version 1's face-free first acceptance (§8.3): one neutral, impermeant ligand; patch populations, outward on a cell's contact patch to its node and inward on its wall patch; site-conserving internalisation into the patch's cell; a static accessible fraction; scheduled binding and internalisation multipliers; ARS(2,2,2) at the declared 1 ms, on the references' ladder 1, 0.5 and 0.25 ms for q1_fast. Every world is the references' own registered world, synthetic (D152 §2.4's rule): K_d = 1 uM, k_on = 1e3 /(mM s), k_int = 0.1 /s, 1e5 copies, q1_fast 100 times faster. Not claimed: contact populations in a run (milestone 1's stage A checks their layout only); composition with D150's or D152's operators in a run; faces (the later composition item, second order against transport, A.6); RK4 (refused); site occupancy beside a bath schedule (out of scope: the lead's ruling; refused at registration by the operator's view conflicts, admitted in development since FR-23 (D244, e7a54539), so Q6's view_conflict_bath_schedule class was retired on 22 November 2026); the species cap's refusal (FR-43 part 1, D315, raises the cap from 16 to 1,024 after the judged run, so Q6's species_cap class, a 17-species world, was retired on 23 November 2026: the lead's ruling; the cap is an engine limit with its own tests); the doors of §9; any biological comparison

worlds.builders: validation/tissue/site_occupancy_acceptance_fixtures.py: the engine-layout adapter. It builds every world from its physical description in validation/fr3/references/reference_inputs.json (the references' registered worlds, registered at 992ce385 and amended before any engine output), on secreted_species_fixtures' quiescent worlds with site_occupancy_fixtures' population and with_site_occupancy. Every cell node is a cell with its wall patch on the held bath (zero permeability, the electrical gauge only); every finite_outside node a finite node; an outward population sits on its cell's contact patch to its node (contact_<cell>_<node>, the only link: no face); an inward population on its cell's wall patch, facing inside. The ligand L is the engine's neutral species S, at its listed concentration at every node and at the world's trace in the bath; the world's trace_mM is the ligand's declared trace (form (a), §4.3). An internalisation multiplier listed for a population without the route is dropped (the engine refuses a schedule for an undeclared route; no law reads it). Records on the step grid at the registered record times. Admitted, every world, rung and control (parse and timeline), 18 November 2026, before any run

budgets.status: declared 18 November 2026 by the FR owner, before any engine output of a protocol world (FR-10's rule, the lead's ruling of 17 November 2026: closed forms from declared values, declared first; the dt study reports against them as development), and confirmed by the lead the same day, before any engine output (questions_answered 1). Their basis is reference-side only: /mnt/workspaces/Cells/site-occupancy-fr3-20261118/authoring/budget_window.json
budgets.B_state: every amount: the free ligand at each cell and finite node, and each population's B, R and internalised cargo, against R-ode at every record (and against R-closed and R-eq where they apply), within B_state + 10 x the reference's own floor of that quantity at that record, with B_state = 2e-5 S_world, S_world = sum_k alpha_k nu_k N_k / N_f the world's declared accessible sites (positive in every world). Basis (the window table): every registered state control but the registered zero-power entries departs by at least 16 x B_state (q3_internalisation's k_int 1%, 5.4e-8 fmol against 3.3e-9; 40 x to 7,400 x elsewhere), so each keeps the lead's 10 x; the background guard's response changes lie 11 x (n), 16 x (internalised) and 29 x (B) below it; 10 x the reference's floor is below B_state for every quantity but the free ligand in the 1e6 pL nodes at alpha < 1 (q4_alpha_1_2_high and q4_alpha_1_4_high: 1.4 and 1.7 x), which the floor term carries; the honest SSPRK(3,3) stand-in errs at least 8,000 x below it at 1 ms. 1e-5 would leave the guard's n change only 5.5 x below; 3e-5 the weakest control only 10.8 x above. Thirteen worlds carry no registered state control: q1_eps_1e-2, q1_eps_1e-3, q2_large, the six Q4 worlds (their power is Q4's ratio controls), q5_passive_from_zero, q5_passive_preformed and the background pair: there the budget has no registered control power (stated, not claimed)
budgets.B_energy: the heat and the work against R-ode's integrals at every record, within 1e-3 x the world's largest reference |heat| (or |work|) over the run + 10 x the reference's floor (the lead's ruling: no heat or work tolerance tighter than about 1e-3 on a trace-dependent quantity; one fraction for every world). A passive world's reference books no work, and the engine's must be exactly 0. The heat to equilibrium (Q2's three worlds): within 1e-3 of |G(start) - G(eq)|. Where a world's energy does not depend on the trace (binding only, from a facing node above the trace), the honest error over B_energy is reported beside it, so the margin there is seen (the lead's ruling 1)
budgets.closure: the design's guard of record (§3.4 item 1, D152 §3.4's form): at every record of every engine part, |the energy ledger's residual| <= 2.5 eps x steps x the energy ledger's magnitude (the operator is the only energy flow in a face-free world)
budgets.ledgers: every material, charge and own ledger within the engine's own bound at every record (ratio <= 1); the ligand's system total (free in every cell and finite node + bound) within its declared floor (1e-20 fmol) + N eps max_t |total| (FR-4's allowance, computed by the judge from the records)
budgets.orders: q1_fast's free ligand at both nodes and B, on the registered ladder: each rung's error against R-ode (the max norm over the shared records), its floor the reference's largest floor + N eps max|q|, both successive pairs classed by FR-4's rule in the band [2.8, 3.2] (nominal 3 +/- 0.2: §8.3's third order; the stand-in shows 3.04 and 3.02, SSPRK(2,2) 2.04 and 2.02, Euler 1.00)
budgets.Q4_margin: M_Q4 = 1e-3 on |B(alpha, t)/B(1, t) - alpha| at every record t > 0, both regimes, alpha = 1/2 and 1/4: at least 1e3 x the registered depletion term (1.64e-7; §8.3's rule asks M_Q4 >= 1.6e-4) and at least 490 x below every judged control's departure
budgets.controls_margin: each control world departs from its arm's reference by at least 10 x the arm's budget on the same quantity; each plant is flagged at exactly its row, with a margin of at least 10 x its check's bound (the lead's ruling)
budgets.batch: each batched world within 1e-12 relative of its scalar run (FR-1's ruling 4)

criteria.C0_admission: every run part admitted and run to its end with every host check on every accepted row (the runner)
criteria.Q1: in each Q1 world at the declared 1 ms and at every rung of q1_fast's ladder, every amount within B_state and the heat and work within B_energy of R-ode at every record; q1_fast's free ligand at both nodes and B at third order on the ladder (the orders budget). Reported: the heat's and the work's orders (second order expected: the share, §4.5) and, reference side, the order in eps of R-ode against R-qss, a property of the references (the lead's ruling 8)
criteria.Q2: in q2_large, q2_closed and q2_two_populations every amount within B_state of R-ode at every record; the last record's B of each population and free ligand at the facing node within B_state of R-eq; q2_closed's last B within B_state of the depletion quadratic's r-; the total heat at the last record within 1e-3 of R-eq's G(start) - G(eq); the heat within B_energy of R-ode's at every record
criteria.Q3: in q3_association, q3_dissociation, q3_internalisation and q3_binding_multiplier every amount within B_state of R-ode at every record, and the heat and work within B_energy; wherever the references give the Riccati form (one population on a closed node, binding only), B and the free ligand within B_state of it at every record
criteria.Q4: the six Q4 worlds and q1_eps_1e-1_alpha_half within B_state of R-ode at every record; |B(alpha, t)/B(1, t) - alpha| <= M_Q4 at every record t > 0 at c = 0.01 K_d and 100 K_d, alpha = 1/2 and 1/4 (the equilibrium ratio, saturation at alpha and a relaxation rate independent of alpha in one statement); the kinetic factor (K) departs by at least 10 M_Q4 in both regimes and the affinity factor (A) at 100 K_d; (A) at 0.01 K_d reported (zero power, the references' finding)
criteria.Q5: the closure at rounding at every record of every engine part; every heat field non-negative and non-decreasing to that rounding at every record; every ledger within its bound and the system total within its allowance; the background guard: the engine's change from t = 0 of every amount in q5_background_threshold against q5_background_lowered at most B_state / 10 (the lead's ruling 2: the guard reads changes from t = 0, since the t = 0 difference is the declared trace content, and 'far below' is at least 10 x below B_state; on the references' pair the margins are 11 x for n, 16 x for the internalised cargo and 29 x for B); the planted controls each flagged at exactly its row by at least 10 x
criteria.Q6: every restart bitwise the straight run from its time and K4's moved switch not; each batched world within 1e-12 of its scalar run and bitwise its place in the reversed batch (bitwise to the scalar run reported); every multiplier zero, and no populations, bitwise the world without the operator on every inner field and row; the value twins identical in program text and closed-over constants; worlds of different structure refused by the batch signature with its reason; each refusal class's representative refused by its own check with its reason, its neighbour admitted and run; the stage condition refusing at run time, its neighbour admitted

controls.K_rates: q1_fast at 1 ms with every k_on, k_off or k_int x 1.01 (three runs) against R-ode's q1_fast: each at least 10 x B_state (registered 1.6e-7 to 2.0e-7 fmol)
controls.K_alpha: q1_eps_1e-1_alpha_half with alpha 1 (alpha ignored) against its R-ode: at least 10 x B_state (registered 8.9e-6 fmol)
controls.K_binding_multiplier: q3_binding_multiplier with its multiplier ignored and squared (two runs): each at least 10 x B_state (registered 1.6e-6 fmol)
controls.K_internalisation_multiplier: q5_class_switch with m_i = 1 throughout: at least 10 x B_state (registered 1.4e-5 fmol)
controls.K_cell_volume: the receiving cell's volume taken as 1 pL: q5_inward's state at least 10 x B_state (registered 3.1e-7 fmol); q1_eps_1e-1's work at least 10 x its B_energy (registered 3.3e-5 pJ; its state moves 5.8e-19 fmol: zero power)
controls.Q4_K_and_A: the kinetic factor (K: alpha 1 with both directions x alpha, the binding multiplier at alpha) and the affinity factor (A: alpha 1 with k_on x alpha) at alpha = 1/2 and 1/4 in both regimes (eight runs), on Q4's ratio
controls.K4: Q6_restart's restart with its switch moved one step is not bitwise the straight run
controls.plants: each a checkpoint edit at one row in its own process, its identity and size in its bundle (the lead's ruling): a misbooked move (the facing node's free ligand raised by 1e-6 of the net bound amount, the accumulator unchanged: @3's outside ledger, refused by the engine on resuming); a misbooked bound pool (B raised by 1e-6 of B, R unchanged: the operator's own ledgers, refused by the engine); the work x (1 + 1e-6) (the registered energy control) in q1_eps_1e-1; the facing node's heat negated; and the site free energy dropped, the facing node's heat set to H + dG_site (the heat a booking without the site term books, dG_site from A.3's form in the plant's process; the lead's ruling 4). The energy plants are detected by the guard of record on the edited row, the judge's closure criterion, far tighter than the engine's run-time bound (the lead's ruling 3); the engine's own verdict on resuming is reported beside it: under ARS its bound, 2e-8 pJ + 2e-3 x the flows, does not refuse a 1e-6 misbooking, evidence for FR-18 (the composite's energy check). The heat-sign and dropped-site-term plants are also judged by the planted heat's sign (the judge's 'dissipation' check: the facing node's heat negative on the edited row); on resuming, the engine refuses both by its energy ledger, which it checks before its own dissipation check. Every unplanted row before a plant within every check, the planted row flagged by the plant's check with every other material check passing, and the margin stated in the bundle
controls.not_declarable: the internalised cargo sent to the wrong node and m_b applied to k_on alone cannot be declared without changing the engine: their power stays with the references, their registered deviations (1.9e-5 to 2.3e-5 fmol and 2.6e-5 fmol, at least 5,500 x B_state), stated, not run (never a patch; the lead's ruling 9). Every declarable control has its engine control world
controls.lower_orders: SSPRK(2,2) and Euler cannot be declared either: the registered stand-in shows their orders on q1_fast (2.04 and 2.02; 1.00), which the band [2.8, 3.2] rejects

checks: q1_fast's orders in the band [2.8, 3.2] for the free ligand at both nodes and B
every rung of every development world within B_state and B_energy of R-ode at every record

dt_study_criteria_written_first.verdict: the declared 1 ms stands if every check holds; otherwise the finest rung that passes is reported to the lead, not repaired

harness_limits: a part ended by its runtime limit or memory cap is a harness failure, not a verdict: the judged run is void and is relaunched once, whole, from the same snapshot; a second harness failure goes to the lead. An engine refusal is a verdict
recording_rules: the generator writes records only (results.json per unit); the judge reads records and never runs; parts from more than one source are refused
every record carries the snapshot's identity; a judged run comes from a clean snapshot
undefined values are None, never NaN; a None fails its criterion
records are aligned on integer milliseconds (round(t / 1 ms)), never by float equality
reported_not_judged: each reference's floor, and the window table's 10 x floor over B_state
the heat's and the work's observed orders on q1_fast (second order expected, §4.5)
the order in eps of R-ode against R-qss (reference side: 0.97 and 0.997 registered; a property of the references, the lead's ruling 8)
the honest heat and work errors over B_energy in every world, those whose energy does not depend on the trace marked (the lead's ruling 1)
(A) at 0.01 K_d (zero power, the lead's ruling 5), and each control's and plant's margin
the engine's own verdict on resuming each energy plant: under ARS its run-time bound (2e-8 pJ + 2e-3 x the flows) does not refuse a 1e-6 misbooking, evidence for FR-18 (the lead's ruling 3)
§4.8's claim 1, every existing composition identical under the constants-aware crossrev: cross-revision, D148's landing record (the lead's ruling 7); milestone 1 changed no shared code (§12)
each batched world's bitwise equality to its scalar run
the engine's estimated relaxation rate per alpha
compile time, memory and cost per step
what_it_does_not_show: no biological comparison (D151) and no receptor-kinetic values (every value synthetic, §8.4); no faces, contacts in a run, composition with D150's or D152's operators, charged ligands, RK4, or site occupancy beside a bath schedule (refused; the lead's scope ruling); no §9 door. The references' zero-power cases (their design file's zero_power; the lead's ruling): Q1's third order in the slow worlds, where an honest error is at rounding at every rung (shown in q1_fast); the work's control in passive worlds, which book no work (carried by the internalising worlds); the receiving cell's volume on q1_eps_1e-1's state (5.8e-19 fmol: shown on its work and in q5_inward); k_on in q3_dissociation (1.3e-10 fmol: k_on has power in every binding world); the affinity factor (A) at c << K_d (2.5e-3 and 1.9e-3 of theta: caught at 100 K_d); the background guard on heat and work (the references' finding: RT ln c carries the trace's logarithm, through the receiving cell's potential; 6.9e-5 and 1.9e-4 relative, 14 x and 5.3 x below B_energy; engine and references share the trace, so the comparisons are unaffected; the lead's ruling 2). The per-law NumPy dG test on random states (R-dG, §3.4 item 2): not shown in this version, since the references' usage note gives it no entry point; it can be added only through a dated references amendment that adds one (the lead's ruling 6), and the world-level closure at rounding and the heat and work against R-ode's integrals carry the energy claim here. §4.8's claim 1 is reported, not judged (cross-revision). Not declarable, so not run: the wrong destination, m_b on k_on alone and the lower-order steppers (their power stays with the references, the lead's ruling 9). Thirteen worlds carry no registered state control (budgets). Integration grants no acceptance (D143)
outcome_rules: a criterion passes or fails as written; a failed criterion is reported, not repaired; the protocol passes when every judged criterion passes

questions_answered: 1. Budgets (the lead, 18 November 2026): confirmed. B_state = 2e-5 S_world, plus 10 x the reference's floor per record; B_energy = 1e-3 of each world's largest reference |heat| or |work|; passive worlds book exactly 0 work. Where a world's energy does not depend on the trace, the honest error is reported beside B_energy, so the margin there is seen

2. The background guard (the lead, 18 November 2026): confirmed as proposed. It reads the changes from t = 0, because the t = 0 difference is the declared trace content; 'far below' means at least 10 x below B_state, and the references' pair passes with 11 x (n), 16 x (internalised) and 29 x (B), the margins stated. Heat and work go under what_it_does_not_show, with the references' finding as the reason: RT ln c carries the trace's logarithm

3. The plants' detector (the lead, 18 November 2026): confirmed as proposed. The energy plants are detected by the guard of record on the edited row, the judge's closure criterion, far tighter than the engine's run-time bound; the engine's own verdict is reported beside it. Under ARS, 2e-8 pJ + 2e-3 x the flows does not refuse a 1e-6 misbooking: evidence for FR-18 (the composite's energy check finding), named in the report line

4. The site free energy dropped (the lead, 18 November 2026): confirmed as proposed. The checkpoint edit of the facing node's heat to H + dG_site, made in its own process, is caught by the closure and by the dissipation check
5. M_Q4 = 1e-3 (the lead, 18 November 2026): confirmed; (A) at c << K_d is reported as zero power

6. R-dG (the lead, 18 November 2026): not shown in this version, listed under what_it_does_not_show with its reason; it can be added later only through a dated references amendment that adds the entry point

7. §4.8 (the lead, 18 November 2026): claim 1, the crossrev of the existing compositions, is reported, since it is cross-revision and D148's landing record; claim 2 and the operator's value twins are judged
8. Q1 (b), the order in eps of R-ode against R-qss (the lead, 18 November 2026): reported, not judged, since it is a property of the references
